problems.quote: GLIMS integrated with ISRO ’s Resourcesat‑2A and Cartosat‑3 provides near‑real‑time lake‑area alerts
problems.problem: GLIMS is a global glacier database, not an operational near‑real‑time alert system integrated with ISRO satellites.
problems.correction: ISRO’s Resourcesat‑2A and Cartosat‑3 provide near‑real‑time lake‑area alerts
problems.verifierReason: GLIMS is a glacier database, not a real-time alert system. Correction attributes alerts to ISRO satellites, which support such monitoring.
